title: Football-field-sized vehicles moving through the ocean at 500 knots

tellings.quote: There are vehicles the size of a football field that are moving through the ocean at 500 knots.
When Lou mentioned the giant underwater thing moving at, you know, 500 knots underwater, that's something this guy talked about.
tellings.difference: Credits Lue Elizondo, not Marco Rubio, and links the claim to the 4chan whistleblower; no football-field size is given.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell the claim that huge objects move underwater at 500 knots.

as_told.title: Lue Elizondo on a giant underwater object moving at 500 knots

plain: The claim is that craft as big as a football field are moving through the world's oceans at 500 knots, far faster than any known submarine. If true, something with technology far beyond ours would be travelling unseen under the sea. The comedian and podcaster Joe Rogan tells Michels this as something the politician Marco Rubio said, and he credits the documentary The Age of Disclosure as the source. The YouTuber Chris Ramsay tells a similar version on the show, but he gets it from somewhere else. He says Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who has spoken publicly about UFOs, talked about "the giant underwater thing moving at, you know, 500 knots underwater." Ramsay says this matches what an anonymous poster called the 4chan whistleblower had written on 4chan, an anonymous online message board. Ramsay gives no size for the object, and he credits Elizondo, not Rubio.
